about: gbrain-access-leaks-2026-11: gbrain's value (rules against no brain on the expiry-on twins) and its leaks (open against rules, rules against no brain with a 3-point margin) over six harness and model setups, from the stored evidence of every scored trial: the run summary, the gbrain pairs with the leak tags, the headroom table, the preregistered endpoints, the unmapped records and their mapping, and the negation and filler checks.

not_rebuilt.what: The merged trial list and per-shard receipts (results/trials.jsonl, manifest.json, shards.json and each shard's manifest, run summary, ledger, proxy usage, run log and leak preflight record)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were written by the run itself and merged from each VM's results with scripts/merge-shards.ts; verify uses them as the run's receipts.

not_rebuilt.what: The content check of the harness transcripts
not_rebuilt.reason: It reads each turn's harness transcript (logs/turns), which stays in the private raw archive because it carries the harness vendors' own system prompts; analysis/content-check.ts rebuilds it from that archive.
